descriptors.name: Endocrine System Diseases
descriptors.scope_note: Pathological processes of the endocrine glands.

descriptors.name: Metabolic Diseases
descriptors.scope_note: Generic term for diseases caused by an abnormal metabolic process.

descriptors.name: Glucose Metabolism Disorders
descriptors.scope_note: Pathological conditions in which glucose metabolism is abnormal.

descriptors.name: Diabetes Mellitus
descriptors.scope_note: A heterogeneous group of disorders characterized by hyperglycemia and glucose intolerance.

descriptors.name: Diabetes Mellitus, Type 2
descriptors.scope_note: A subclass of diabetes mellitus that is not insulin-responsive.

descriptors.name: Diabetes Mellitus, Type 1
descriptors.scope_note: A subtype of diabetes mellitus characterized by insulin deficiency.
